description: Query any City of Montreal datastore resource (donnees.montreal.ca, CKAN) by its resource id (a UUID). Supports a free-text `q`, exact-match `filters` (field→value), `sort` ("field desc"), limit and offset. Use montreal_datasets to find a resource id, or montreal_recent for the common ones.

filters.description: Exact-match filters as a JSON object, e.g. {"district":"B2"}.

name: montreal_query
